profile.headline: Software Engineer | JS / TS / Node / Python
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: DevOps engineer with 5+ years turned software engineer, with experience working across the whole software development lifecycle. Supported operations from conception through post-release support. Creator of efficient code and exciting user experiences. Eager to elevate ongoing development projects as well as bring clients ideas to fruition.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full stack web applications from end to end utilizing HTML, CSS and Javascript to design and Node.js to execute
• Facilitated systematic code review sessions, collaborating with 6 team members to ensure best practices and coding st andards 
• Accumulated a clientele through various projects delivering optimal solutions for small businesses, increasing their internet presence
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · JavaScript · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and implemented complete CI/CD pipelines using Git, Jenkins, and Nolio, reducing deployment times by 30% and cutting post-release patches by 40%
• Managed and optimized over 120 change requests annually, resulting in improved release efficiency and an increase in the Excellence in Engineering (EIE) grade from 'C' to 'A'
• Built and maintained release pipelines with robust error handling and rollback capabilities, resulting in 99.8% successful deployments
• Conducted post-release validation with automated test suites, significantly reducing incidents in production environments by 25%
positions.insights: Skills: Service-now.com · Version Control · Python (Programming Language) · Domain Name System (DNS) · User Acceptance Testing · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Debugging · Git · Release Management · Jira Align · ServiceNow · Incident Management · SQL · Jenkins · Agile Methodologies · Nolio · Jira

positions.title: IT Analyst
positions.description:
• Resolved 100+ weekly IT support tickets with 95% customer satisfaction rating, addressing user issues across hardware, software, and network systems
• Managed user access and privileges using Active Directory for 500+ users, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and organizational security protocols
• Performed diagnostics and troubleshooting for 40+ devices weekly, maintaining an average resolution time of under 4 hours
• Provided end-user training and created documentation for common issues, reducing repeat ticket volume by 30%
positions.insights: Skills: Application Development · Active Directory · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Information Technology Professional
positions.description:
• 15 week computer technician training program
• Combination of formal classroom training and real-world working environment
• CompTIA A+ and Network+ (Pending) Certifications

positions.title: Admissions Operations Intern
positions.description:
• Organized an effective social media marketing plan to expand reach to target audience of young adults ages 18-24, resulting in a 50% increase in following for Facebook 
• Interviewed and selected participants for the September 2013 and March 2014 program class based on academic test scores and professional qualifications
• Created database to manage information of over 59 New York City community boards for program outreach opportunities
• Facilitated bi-weekly open house presentations to communicate to 15 prospects per session about the benefits of the Year Up program and how it might have been a great fit for each candidate
